# Raw independent codings — DO NOT EDIT

These are the two coders' round-2 outputs exactly as produced, before any agreement analysis,
adjudication or consensus. They are the evidentiary basis for the reliability statistics and
must never be overwritten with consensus values.

Disagreements are preserved here deliberately. A reliability coefficient computed on
adjudicated codes measures nothing.

If adjudicated or consensus codes are ever produced, they go in a SEPARATE file. These two
stay as they are.
